新增:- **G3 步骤备注:并进链路明细节、每条带步骤编号**:链路明细里抽出的 `note` 不另开一节,收进链路明细这一节的最后一组 `Group`(`title` 写「步骤备注」),紧接最后一个产品组、组间仍用 48px;组内按 `chains[]` 顺序一个产品一段,段首一个 `Text` 写 `{product} · {version}`,下面一个 `List`(`items` 的 `title` 写「第 {no} 步 · {screen}」、`description` 写 `note`),编号与链路明细里该步 `FigureLabel` 完全一致,读者可逐条对上截图;整组占 9 列、单列排(`List` 不写 `columns`),不排两列;`note` 为空字符串的步骤不列,某产品所有 `note` 都为空时该产品不列,所有产品都为空时这一组不出现。

请按这条规则修改 Page.tsx:只改和这条规则有关的地方,其他部分保持原样;如果页面已经符合这条规则,就不要改,直接结束。改了就运行检查。

Now the current Page.tsx has a "步骤备注" Group with a single flat List combining all products' notes. G3 requires: one product per segment, segment starts with a Text `{product} · {version}`, then a List with titles 「第 {no} 步 · {screen}」 and description note.

Let me check the existing Page.tsx (it may already be modified? No, it's the old version). So I need to modify.

Let me write the new step notes group. Compute per chain notes.

I'll restructure:

```tsx
const chainNotes = data.chains
  .map((chain) => ({
    product: chain.product,
    version: chain.version,
    notes: chain.steps
      .filter((step) => step.note)
      .map((step) => ({ title: `第 ${step.no} 步 · ${step.screen}`, description: step.note })),
  }))
  .filter((c) => c.notes.length > 0)
```

Then in the section:

```tsx
{chainNotes.length > 0 && (
  <Group title="步骤备注" className="gap-12">
    {chainNotes.map((c) => (
      <Group key={c.product}>
        <Text>{`${c.product} · ${c.version}`}</Text>
        <List items={c.notes} />
      </Group>
    ))}
  </Group>
)}
```

Hmm, nested Groups. Alternatively avoid nested Groups by... Actually maybe simpler and more aligned: since Section has gap-12 (48px), and the 步骤备注 group is a Group. Inside, segments at 48px and Text→List at 24px. Using nested Group is the way with available components. Let me check whether Group accepts className — yes.

Actually, wait: does the "整组占 9 列" matter? Section children are in the 9-col area already, so fine.

Alternatively, use `<Grid cols={9} fields={false} className="gap-12">`? Grid doesn't have gap-12 spacing between rows... Section children get default gap 192px? No — Section's children spacing default is 192px? "Section: 子元素之间默认 192px". Hmm, "节之间默认 192px" for Page, and Section 子元素之间默认 192px too. That's why the current code uses className="gap-12" (48px) for the 流程明细 section. So within that Section, children are 48px apart: the product Groups and the 步骤备注 Group. Good.

Within the 步骤备注 Group default 24px. I want segments 48px → className="gap-12" on the outer Group. And inner Groups default 24px between Text and List.

Hmm, but is nesting Group inside Group acceptable visually? It just renders children with gap. Fine.

Let me also double check: the List with numbered? G3 doesn't say numbered; it says List with title/description. The old flat list had no numbering. Keep without numbered.

Now edit Page.tsx.

页面结构:页头(任务/范围/日期 + 标题)→ 结论 → 核心指标(一行 4 个)→ 产品对比 → 阶段对比 → 共性规律 → 流程明细(三家银行各一组截图链路 + 步骤备注)→ 问题明细 → 下一步 → 背景信息。
